function: MAPPO agents learn focal-point displacements that set the tilt of reflector tiles, maximizing mean RSSI at users from user locations, without CSI (pp. 4-5).
system: Reflecting array of 72 mechanically tilted metallic tiles (called an IRS); AP with 4 antennas, three single-antenna UEs; 60 GHz indoor NLOS hallway (pp. 4, 9).
method: MAPPO (multi-agent PPO), centralized training with decentralized execution; reinforcement learning trained in the Sionna ray-tracing simulator; two 256-unit hidden layers (pp. 8-9).
data_channel: Sionna ray tracing in a Blender L-shaped hallway model with ITU-R P.2040 materials at 60 GHz; users moving randomly; simulation only (pp. 6-7, 9, 11).
test_conditions: Trained on three users with the r7 array; tested without retraining on 2-4 users and 5-11 rows; noise cases trained separately (pp. 12-13, 15).
baselines: No reflector and static flat reflector (non-learned); single-agent RL beam-focusing; multi-agent column-based variant of the proposed method (pp. 10-12).
metrics: Average RSSI (dBm) and its gain in dB over baselines; training reward; recovery time in simulation steps after user movement; RSSI maps (pp. 10-13).
complexity: Only the control-space reduction factor 2NrNc/3L, about 16 for 72 tiles and 3 agents (p. 5); no FLOPs, parameter count or runtime.
openness: GitHub link https://github.com/hieutrungle/saris_revised ('Our work is publicly available', p. 2).
q1_support: p. 6: "deterministic propagation engine [42] with" - Sionna ray tracing in a custom Blender scene; p. 7: "The material parameter specification follows ITU-R Recommendation P.2040 [46], which" - materials only; no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 12: "policies pretrained exclusively on three-user scenarios to control reflectors in two-, three-, and four-user configurations,"; p. 13: "across different hardware configurations without requiring" retraining (r7 to r5-r11).
q3_support: p. 11: "distinct approaches: no reflector baseline, flat static reflector," - non-learned baselines exist, but the learned ones (single-agent beam-focusing, column-based multi-agent) are variants of the proposed method; no earlier learned RIS method is compared.
q4_support: p. 5: "dimensionality reduction, with the control space reduced from" - only the control-space reduction factor (about 16); no operations, parameter count or runtime.
q5_support: p. 2: "Our work is publicly available at https://github.com/hieutrungle/saris_revised."
notes: Area 3: the learned MAPPO policy configures the tilt of a mechanical reflector array, called an intelligent reflecting surface on p. 4, the analogue of RIS configuration; ris=1 although p. 2 contrasts it with electronic RIS. Reviewer to confirm: q1 (Sionna on a custom scene, not a listed model or public dataset); q3 (if single-agent RL counts as a standard algorithm on the same problem, q3=1); q4 (only a control-space reduction factor). Tile count is 72 on p. 9 but r7 has 63 tiles on p. 13.
